description: This file defines the ProductMixNotFoundException class which extends an abstract exception class, indicating that no product mixes were found for a given productId. It provides constructors to initialize the exception message with productId information.

classes.name: ProductMixNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating that no product mix was found for a given product ID.

methods.description: Constructor that creates the exception with a message incorporating the productId.
